items.prompt:
Images, charts, and sound in a presentation are:
A) multimedia components
B) counterclaims
C) citations

A chart in a presentation mainly helps to:
A) clarify data
B) hide the point
C) waste time

Multimedia in a presentation should:
A) support and strengthen the message
B) distract from it
C) replace the content
items.answer: A) support and strengthen the message

steps: Support, not distract. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) support and strengthen the message

items.prompt:
Why add a line graph to a talk on rising sea levels?
A) it clarifies the data and strengthens the claim
B) it hides the data
C) it is just decoration
items.answer: A) it clarifies the data and strengthens the claim

solution.answer: A) it clarifies the data and strengthens the claim

items.prompt:
A student plays loud, unrelated music over every slide. The problem is the media:
A) distracts from the message
B) strengthens the message
C) adds useful evidence

To INTEGRATE multimedia smoothly means:
A) each visual appears where it clarifies or strengthens a claim
B) pile all visuals on one slide
C) use media with no connection to the topic
items.answer: A) each visual appears where it clarifies or strengthens a claim

steps: Woven in to support. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) each visual appears where it clarifies or strengthens a claim

items.prompt:
Which slide BEST strengthens a claim that a city's air quality has improved?
A) a clear line graph of pollution levels dropping over five years
B) a cluttered slide of unrelated photos
C) a blank slide
items.answer: A) a clear line graph of pollution levels dropping over five years

steps: Relevant, clear visual. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a clear line graph of pollution levels dropping over five years

items.prompt:
The MAIN purpose of integrating multimedia into a presentation is to:
A) clarify information and strengthen claims and evidence
B) show off software skills
C) fill silence
items.answer: A) clarify information and strengthen claims and evidence

solution.answer: A) clarify information and strengthen claims and evidence
